verdict.rationale: Base44 is an AI app builder whose agents and Superagents could plausibly act as MCP clients, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Base44 acting as an MCP server for external assistants (App MCP, account MCP, Docs MCP). Its agents 'connect to tools' only through first-party integrations like Slack and Notion, and nothing shows a user plugging in arbitrary third-party MCP servers.
